description: This Java class 'ReadableOrderPopulator' is responsible for converting (populating) an 'Order' entity object into a 'ReadableOrder' data transfer object, including mapping order details, billing and delivery addresses, and various order totals.

classes.name: ReadableOrderPopulator
classes.description: A class extending AbstractDataPopulator that converts an Order object into a ReadableOrder DTO, including address and total details.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to transform an Order into a ReadableOrder, mapping basic info, addresses, and totals.

methods.name: createTotal
methods.description: Helper method to create a ReadableOrder total object from an OrderTotal entity.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Method intended to create an empty ReadableOrder target; currently returns null.
